name: Martingale (on Red)

claim_quotes: It is often called almost fool-proof and a guaranteed win over the very short-term.
you'll recover any previous losses plus gain a small profit

notes: BACKTESTED by a prior discovery run (registered as 'Martingale on Red'): EV/unit -2.56%, session win rate 38.2%, risk of ruin 58.8%. The 'guaranteed short-term win' is real per session but paid for by rare catastrophic losses; negative-EV overall, matching the house edge.
